anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps all three facts: Turn 1 decodes `2 more fix rounds` as budget-only, routes the acceptance-criteria item straight to the human menu, and stops without applying; the continuation prints `funded round 1 of 2 for task 3` without asking the human, re-decodes the grant via a read-only delegate, dispatches the implementer on a repair-base snapshot of the current integrated tree with `model: "<configured-impl-model>"` and `async: false`, runs the scoped `node --test frame.test.mjs` gate, dispatches the wave-reviewer re-review, and only then commits and marks task 3 complete. Nothing moved. One regression worth noting that no fact captures: Before carried a commit-boundary guard (`rev-parse HEAD` vs `WAVE_BASE_SHA`) because the `amend:` audit commit landed in this checkout during the aftermath, whereas After runs `reset --soft '<WAVE_BASE_SHA>'` unconditionally, which would fold that audit commit into the wave commit. To keep Before's behaviour while still delivering the one-transition-table change, retain the HEAD check before the isolated-wave commit (or reset to HEAD rather than WAVE_BASE_SHA when an amend commit has advanced it), and keep the explicit `diff --stat` emptiness check before the gate as After already does.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: No fact moved. After keeps the menu-and-stop turn and actually sharpens the budget-only point by quoting the header literally and stating it supplies two funded rounds, not amendment permission; it also prints `funded round 1 of 2 for task 3` without asking for approval and runs the same configured-implModel, async:false, current-integrated-snapshot repair followed by scoped tests, a wave re-review, wave commit, then tracker completion. Two small things worth preserving from Before in future wording: After drops the explicit `test "$GATE_EXIT" -eq 0 || exit` guard after the scoped command (Before had it), so a reader relying on the text alone must trust the prose that the gate passes before review dispatch—restoring that one line keeps the gate strictly ordered before review; and Before's `git status --porcelain` admission step is gone, which is harmless here but was a useful retained-state check. Otherwise the After wording delivers the Change (current-tree repair, delta-only integration, single integrated wave review, no report-relay worker) while holding every fact Before held.
